repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的免费临时邮箱服务，支持收发邮件、附件处理、IMAP/SMTP 协议及 Telegram 机器人通知，采用 Rust WASM 实现高性能邮件解析，提供现代化多语言响应式界面，支持邮箱地址密码保护，完全免费且无需服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: A fully-featured free temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting email sending/receiving, attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot notifications. Uses Rust WASM for high-performance email parsing, offers a modern responsive UI with multi-language support, and enables password protection for email addresses—all at zero cost with no server required.

repos.description: 收集整理远程工作相关的资料
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理远程工作相关资源，涵盖文章、问题解答、团队案例、视频播客、工具站点等，聚焦中国受众，提供远程办公经验分享、招聘信息、协作工具推荐及行业报告，助力远程工作者获取实用信息与职业发展支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates comprehensive resources on remote work, including articles, Q&A, team cases, videos, podcasts, tools, and reports, primarily targeting Chinese audiences. It offers practical guidance on remote work, job opportunities, collaboration tools, and industry insights to support freelancers and remote professionals.

repos.description: Give your agent a computer 👾
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare Computer 是基于 Durable Objects 的虚拟文件系统，以 SQLite 为权威状态存储，提供可插拔执行后端。支持容器化 Linux、just-bash Shell 和 ECMAScript 模块三种运行模式，为 AI 智能体、自动化任务和代码沙箱提供统一执行入口。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem built on Durable Objects with SQLite state management and pluggable execution backends. It supports three modes: containerized Linux, just-bash shell in Dynamic Workers, and ECMAScript modules. Provides a unified execution entry point for AI agents, automation tasks, and code sandboxing on the Cloudflare Workers platform.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects 的免费多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时监控、离线告警，到期通知，历史数据查看、延迟追踪、地图展示等功能。兼容主流Linux系统，Alpine Linux，OpenWrt，macOS，群晖 DSM、飞牛 fnOS、Windows系统。
repos.summary_zh: CF-Server-Monitor 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时追踪 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等指标，提供历史图表、全球地图展示、离线告警及 WebSocket 实时推送。兼容 Linux、Alpine、OpenWrt 和 Windows 系统，集成 JWT 认证与 Turnstile 人机验证，通过 GitHub Actions 实现一键部署，适合运维自动化与多节点监控场景。
repos.summary_en: CF-Server-Monitor is a multi-server monitoring probe system built on Cloudflare Workers and D1, offering real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics with historical charts, global map visualization, offline alerts, and WebSocket-based live updates. Compatible with Linux, Alpine, OpenWrt, and Windows, it integrates JWT authentication and Turnflare Turnstile verification, enabling one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for efficient operations automation and multi-node monitoring.

repos.description: A beautiful screenshot + screen recording + Loom alternative - all native, self hostable and free.
repos.summary_zh: Screendrop 是一款 macOS 原生免费开源的截图与屏幕录制工具，作为 Loom 的自托管替代方案。支持全屏/窗口/区域捕获、视频转录、字幕生成、画中画剪辑，并通过 Cloudflare 实现带搜索与评论功能的链接分享，深度集成 Apple Shortcuts 与 Siri 自动化。
repos.summary_en: Screendrop is a free, native macOS screenshot and screen recording app — an open-source, self-hostable Loom alternative. Features include AI on-device transcription, karaoke captions, video editing with zooms and picture-in-picture, smart redaction, and shareable links with searchable transcripts and comments via Cloudflare. Integrates with Apple Shortcuts, Siri, and Finder for seamless automation.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具专注于自动化注册和验证 Tavily、Firecrawl 及 Exa 的 API Key，支持多服务并发注册、邮箱验证码自动处理、真实接口可用性验证，并可选上传至统一代理池，为 MySearch-Proxy 提供稳定上游密钥源。
repos.summary_en: This toolkit automates registration and validation of API keys for Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It supports concurrent signups, email verification handling, real-time API testing, and optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

repos.description: 完全运行于 Cloudflare Worker的现代聊天系统：实时通信、Telegram 双向桥接、消息与文件加密 A modern, self-hosted team chat built on Cloudflare — realtime messaging, Telegram bridge, encrypted messages & files, and WebMCP. |
repos.summary_zh: EdgeChat 是基于 Cloudflare 全家桶构建的零运维团队聊天系统，支持公开/私有群组、私信与实时消息通信。特色功能为 Telegram 双向消息桥接，Bot 驱动跨平台无缝同步。前端采用 Vue 3 + Hono，Durable Objects 承载 WebSocket 连接，AES-256-GCM 加密保障数据安全，在免费额度内即可落地企业级 IM。
repos.summary_en: EdgeChat is a zero-infrastructure team chat system built on Cloudflare ecosystem, supporting public/private groups, DMs, and real-time messaging. Its standout feature is bidirectional Telegram bridge via Bot for seamless cross-platform sync. Powered by Vue 3 + Hono frontend, Durable Objects for WebSocket, and AES-256-GCM encryption, it delivers enterprise-grade IM within Cloudflare's free tier.

repos.description: A smart and beautiful markdown editor.
repos.summary_zh: Markcook 是一款基于 Vue 2.0 和 Vuex 2.0 开发的智能美观 Markdown 编辑器，采用 Google Material Design 风格。支持多文件切换、拖拽加载、自动保存至本地存储、一键插入 Markdown 语法及导出为 Markdown 或 HTML 文件，提供流畅的动画交互与护眼配色，兼具在线便捷性与本地应用体验。
repos.summary_en: Markcook is a smart and beautiful markdown editor built with VueJS 2.0 and Vuex 2.0, featuring Google Material Design. It supports multi-file editing, drag-and-drop loading, auto-save to local storage, toolbar-based markdown insertion, and export to .md or .html. With smooth animations, low-contrast colors, and componentized architecture, it offers a seamless online experience akin to desktop apps.

repos.description: 📁 轻盈优雅的 Web 原生 Cloudflare R2 桶文件管理器，一切皆在浏览器中完成。 | 📁 A lightweight, elegant, pure-browser Cloudflare R2 file manager. Everything happens right in your browser.
repos.summary_zh: R2 Web 是一款轻量级、优雅的纯浏览器 Cloudflare R2 文件管理器，无需构建或后端服务。它支持拖拽上传、图片压缩、多语言界面、深色模式及 PWA 桌面安装，所有操作均在客户端完成，直连 R2 API，保障数据安全。
repos.summary_en: R2 Web is a lightweight, elegant, pure-browser file manager for Cloudflare R2, with no build step or backend required. It supports drag-and-drop uploads, image compression, multi-language UI, dark mode, and PWA desktop installation—all client-side operations directly connecting to the R2 API.

repos.description: A full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers  | 基于 TanStack Start + Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板
repos.summary_zh: FlareStarter 是一款基于 TanStack Start 与 Cloudflare Workers 构建的全栈、边缘原生 SaaS 起步模板。它集成了鉴权、Stripe 计费、邮件、i18n 及运营后台等核心模块，利用 Cloudflare 全球边缘网络实现毫秒级响应与极低成本。项目强调端到端类型安全，提供开箱即用的生产级代码，支持 fork 即用，旨在帮助开发者快速部署具备商业闭环能力的现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: FlareStarter is a full-stack, edge-native SaaS starter built with TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers. It integrates essential modules like authentication, Stripe billing, email, i18n, and an admin dashboard. Leveraging Cloudflare's global edge network, it delivers millisecond latency and near-zero operational costs. Featuring end-to-end type safety and production-ready code, it enables developers to quickly deploy modern web applications with complete commercial capabilities.

repos.description: 一个简单的网络分析跟踪器和仪表板，在 Cloudflare Pages 上即可快速部署的网站分析仪表板,无成本稳定运行
repos.summary_zh: Han-Analytics 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的无服务器网站分析工具，提供轻量级网络跟踪与可视化仪表板功能，支持零成本部署、高并发访问（每日10万次免费统计），具备密码保护和网站白名单等安全特性，适用于个人或企业快速集成网站数据分析。
repos.summary_en: Han-Analytics is a serverless web analytics tool built on Cloudflare Pages, offering lightweight tracking and dashboard visualization with zero-cost deployment, high-concurrency support (up to 100k daily free stats), password protection, and website whitelisting for secure data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Cloudflare Worker; Claude Code; Proxy; Easy to deploy; Claude Code Router; claude-code-router; ccr
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Worker 的 Claude Code 代理工具，支持将 Gemini 和 OpenAI 等第三方大模型 API 转换为 Claude 格式，实现零配置快速部署。核心特性包括流式响应、工具调用支持，并可通过 One-Balance 实现低成本 Claude Code 使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Cloudflare Worker-based proxy that converts third-party LLM APIs (Gemini, OpenAI) into Claude-compatible format, enabling zero-config deployment. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, tool calls, and integrates with One-Balance for cost-effective Claude Code usage.

repos.summary_zh: EdgeMirror 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 和 Vercel Functions 构建的 CDN 式边缘镜像网关。它通过单一域名路径路由，为 PyPI、PyTorch、Hugging Face、GitHub、Docker 及 Linux 镜像等主流开发者资源提供统一的加速代理，有效解决网络访问受限或速度慢的问题。
repos.summary_en: EdgeMirror is a CDN-style edge mirror gateway built on Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Functions. It provides unified acceleration for major developer resources like PyPI, PyTorch, Hugging Face, GitHub, Docker, and Linux mirrors via single-domain path routing, solving network access and speed issues.

repos.description: 这是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 项目，它充当一个代理服务器，能够将 Claude API 格式的请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式。这使得任何与 Claude API 兼容的客户端（例如官方的 @anthropic-ai/claude-code CLI）都能够与任何支持 OpenAI API 格式的服务进行通信，如 Google Gemini, Groq, Ollama 等。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的 TypeScript 代理服务器，可将 Claude API 请求无缝转换为 OpenAI API 格式，支持动态路由至 Google Gemini、Groq、Ollama 等兼容服务，具备全功能 API 兼容、函数调用转换、Haiku 模型快捷配置及一键部署脚本，实现 Claude 客户端与多 AI 服务的无缝互通。
repos.summary_en: This is a TypeScript project deployed on Cloudflare Workers that acts as a proxy server, seamlessly converting Claude API requests to OpenAI API format. It enables any Claude-compatible client (e.g., @anthropic-ai/claude-code) to communicate with OpenAI-compatible services like Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama via dynamic routing, full API compatibility, tool calling conversion, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: 节点过滤器
repos.summary_zh: ProxyFilter 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Clash 代理配置过滤工具，支持多格式输入（YAML、Base64、URI列表），智能匹配中英文地区名称，过滤 VMess、Shadowsocks、Trojan 等协议节点，自动去重并支持多源合并与自定义命名，适用于高效管理代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: ProxyFilter is a Cloudflare Workers-based tool for filtering Clash proxy configurations. It supports multiple input formats (YAML, Base64, URI lists), intelligently matches region names in Chinese and English, filters nodes by protocol (VMess, Shadowsocks, Trojan, etc.), removes duplicates, and merges multiple sources with customizable naming.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: QuickShare on Cloudflare Workers with R2, D1 and per-user content management
repos.summary_zh: QuickShare Cloudflare 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers、R2 和 D1 构建的轻量级内容分享工具，专为 AI 生成的 HTML、Markdown、SVG 和 Mermaid 内容设计。用户粘贴内容即可生成可分享链接，无需注册或登录，支持可选的 5 位数字密码保护。内容正文存储在 R2，元数据管理在 D1，实现高效分离。每个浏览器自动获得 owner cookie，支持个人后台管理、编辑和删除内容。一键部署到 Cloudflare，完全掌控数据与部署。
repos.summary_en: QuickShare Cloudflare is a lightweight content-sharing tool built on Cloudflare Workers, R2, and D1, designed for AI-generated HTML, Markdown, SVG, and Mermaid content. Users paste content to generate shareable links instantly—no sign-up required—with optional 5-digit password protection. Content bodies are stored in R2, while metadata is managed in D1 for efficient separation. Each browser gets an owner cookie for personal admin control. Fully deployable to Cloudflare with one click, giving you full ownership of data and deployment.
